headline: KISS OF LIFE release first winter single 'Greedy'
sub: A cozy Christmas love song, out now with two B-sides
source: Source: S2 Entertainment via Korean media
caption:
KISS OF LIFE are back with 'Greedy', their first-ever winter single!

Released Nov 25 at 6 PM KST, the title track is a mid-tempo pop song that captures the thrill of the Christmas season, comparing growing feelings in love to tasting something delicious. The single also includes 'December Glow' and 'Imperfect Christmas'.

📌 Source: S2 Entertainment, via Korean media
